status: DRAFT — RULE PRE-REGISTERED, NOT FROZEN, NOT APPLIED, NOT RUN, NO GRANT

rule.candidate_universe: The first 36 acquisition cycles, one orientation per candidate, with positive cycle-36 U strength and cycle membership.
rule.competence_screen: Both baseline A and baseline K must be true in the no-arm A+K+ replay. A row missing either path is ineligible; there is no fallback to a non-competent row.
rule.selection_order: Force the current N4 targets that pass the competence screen. Then visit the remaining eligible edges in ascending sha256('A1-N20-COMPETENT-1|seed|source>target') order and accept an edge only when both endpoint caps remain and the residual graph still admits enough edges to reach 20. The result is the lexicographically earliest 20-edge b-matching, not a first-fit greedy pass. The hash is blind to U magnitude, treatment outputs, reports and outcomes.
rule.overlap: permitted; each tag may appear in at most three selected edges
rule.failure_rule: If fewer than 20 eligible rows can be selected after the degree cap, that seed fails and the block is not run. Do not add non-competent rows, relax the cap, or re-select after seeing treatment data.
rule.preserves_current_n4: Only the current N4 targets that pass the competence screen. The carrier-missing N4 rows are deliberately dropped; this is a replacement N20 block, not a superset of the current N4 set.

feasibility.conclusion: A capacity-respecting b-matching with the current competent N4 rows forced reaches at least 20 on all six seeds: 23-36 A&K-available candidates per seed, and a maximum matching of 23-36 rows under the three-edge endpoint cap. The current N4 block contributes only 12 of its 24 rows; the other 12 are carrier- or admission-missing and are dropped. Existence is not a selected target set, a freeze or a result.

consequences.c2: All selected rows are baseline A/K-competent under the stated reading. Exact C2 remains a treatment measurement; this rule removes the baseline-ineligible rows rather than proving C2 will pass.
consequences.c8: 20 rows give a 1/20 = 0.05 step at the unchanged 0.05 ceiling; one assertion is at the ceiling and two exceed it. The C8 threshold is not changed.
consequences.c1: Unaffected. C1's full-stream K availability remains 31-44 against the 60-row floor; a competent target block cannot repair the denominator.
consequences.estimand: Changes the target population from representative eligible edges to baseline-competent edges. It is a new estimand and cannot be described as a repair of the current representative target set.
consequences.blindness: The screen uses no treatment output and no report field. It is pre-treatment, but it is not future-blind to the 120-cycle no-arm baseline. That limitation is part of the rule.

disposition: This is a draft rule only. It is not adopted, not frozen, not applied and not run. Adopting it requires a separate target-freeze act and a separate dated grant; it does not change the current N4 manifest or authorise an N20 cell.
not_evidence: A pre-registered selection rule and a feasibility count over existing no-arm artifacts. No target edge is selected, no target is frozen, no grant exists, no A1 cell runs and no C2/C8 result is measured.
